All three stages are ticked, so reconcile is short and the roadmap now goes to the completion review.

**Reconcile (since the 2026-10-09 resume)**
- **Stage 3** is stamped COMPLETE (2026-11-04), implemented by plan 5. Its `## Handoff to later stages` section reads `None`, so it changes nothing downstream. The stamp correctly leaves out the "Its Handoff section names…" sentence.
- **No unticked stages remain**, so there is nothing to amend, nothing to raise as a question and nothing to commit at this step.

**Next: roadmap-completion review**

Retirement depends on a conformance audit of the whole system, not just each stage. That means re-running the gap rubric over R1–R6, with evidence for every verdict. These reads come first:

```
Read  specs/parking-occupancy-spec.md                      # R1–R6 as numbered in §2–§4
Read  specs/plans/completed/2-sensor-ingest.md             # Deviation notes, tests for R1–R3
Read  specs/plans/completed/3-occupancy-rates.md           # Deviation notes, hand-count check for R4
Read  specs/plans/completed/5-occupancy-dashboard.md       # Deviation notes, alert test for R5–R6
Read  specs/deferred_items.md                              # any entries tied to R1–R6
Grep  "every|interval|minutes|POLL" sensors/               # confirm R3: 5-minute poll replaced the 15-minute one at sensors/poll.py:18
Grep  "bay_events|occupancy|0.95|95" --type py             # loader, dedup, occupancy job, alert rule
Grep  "def test_" tests/                                   # dedup test, 95% alert test, 9-car-park coverage
```

The audit could find a requirement that isn't met, or one met differently with no recorded `> Deviation:`. Each such requirement has only two possible outcomes, and I'll bring both to you:
- **A new stage**, in which case the roadmap stays live.
- **A conscious deferral**, with a written reason.

If all six rows come back implemented-as-specified, or as recorded deviations, I'll show you the table. After you approve it, I'll move the roadmap to `specs/completed/` beside the retired spec. That move is the step that needs your go-ahead.
